thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED — P2 routing errors (dedicated eu-1). Pagerduty escalation to @sara. Initial impact: intermittent 502/504 between edge gateway and dedicated inference pools. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1777654321

sara: I'm on it. Seeing a spike in `connection reset` and `upstream timeout` from routing-proxy -> ded-gw-eu1. Errors start ~08:12 UTC, affecting about 7% of requests to that shard.

mike: CSM heads up — which enterprise customers are pinned to eu-1? Need to prepare comms.

sara: quick list from tenant-mapping:
- Veridian Pay (acct VPD-9001) — high throughput payments traffic, SLOs critical
- Arcadia Finance (acct ACF-3312) — scheduled heavy batch jobs starting 09:00 UTC
- Bluehaven Bank (acct BHB-4450) — low-latency trading endpoints, small traffic percentage
- Civitas Health (acct CVT-2200) — compliance/cold workloads, low traffic

tom: thanks. Mike, recommend we prepare tailored notices for Veridian and Arcadia first, then Bluehaven.

mike: agreed. Drafting short impact statements now. Draft for Veridian: 
> Veridian Pay — Impact: intermittent failed inference requests to production models hosted in the eu-1 dedicated pool. Scope: ~7% of requests between 08:12-ongoing, requests may retry and see increased latency or failures. Mitigation: traffic being rerouted to eu-2 fallback; we expect reduced failures within 10–15 minutes. Action for customer: monitor payments pipeline and retry failed calls. CS will escalate if they observe payment requeueing.

mike: Lina, can you vet the tone? Want clear but not alarmist.

lina: tone OK. Add a line about internal follow-up and postmortem commit. Also include support contact and filing link.

sara: proposed status page update (short):
"We are investigating intermittent request failures affecting customers using dedicated eu-1. We have implemented an automated fallback to eu-2 for affected traffic. Engineers are monitoring. Root cause under investigation."

ops-lead: good. Add ETA for next update in 30 minutes.

sara: mitigation command I'm executing now to route Veridian and Arcadia traffic to eu-2 fallback: 
```json
{
  "route_filter": {
    "tenant_ids": ["VPD-9001","ACF-3312"],
    "target_shard": "dedicated-eu-2",
    "reason": "failover for routing errors in eu-1"
  }
}
```

sara: running `robin route apply --file tmp/reroute-1777654321.json` now.

incident-bot: Action recorded: routing-change by sara at 08:21 UTC. Notify: #customer-safety + matching CSMs.

mike: sending Veridian notice now (via support portal + email). Template below — please copy/paste into ticket: 
"We are experiencing intermittent failures for requests handled by the dedicated eu-1 pool. We have rerouted your production requests to a healthy fallback pool (eu-2). You may observe temporary retries or slightly increased latency. Our team will follow up with a detailed incident summary and remediation timeline."

mike: also pinged Arcadia and added HelixP to watchlist in case of cross-tenant noise (HelixP is low traffic but high priority).

lina: internal comms snippet for sales/AMs: 
> Heads up: an ongoing platform incident is causing intermittent failures for a subset of dedicated eu-1 customers. Veridian Pay and Arcadia Finance are currently routed to eu-2. CS is contacting customers. PX leads: please avoid scheduled demos in affected regions until further notice.

tom: request from legal: capture which API keys triggered errors and preserve logs for potential compliance review.

sara: logs and request traces are being archived to s3://incidents/1777654321/raw-logs. Exporting list of affected API keys now.

pagerduty: Reminder: on-call handoff coming up in 30m. lina please confirm you'll take next rotation.

lina: taking handoff at 08:45 UTC. I'll monitor the reroute health dashboard and coordinate postmortem.

sara: current status: reroute success for Veridian and Arcadia, error rate for eu-1 dropped from 7% -> 0.8%. Still seeing occasional spikes on unrelated tenants; investigating whether routing-proxy config leak caused connection churn.

ops-lead: good work. Next update to customers + status page in 30 minutes. Add incident severity note and expected timeline.

mike: marking Veridian ticket as 'customer notified - mitigation in place'. Posting copy to internal CS channel.

tom: after action: prepare tailored postmortem bullets for each enterprise: (1) impact window, (2) mitigation performed, (3) recommended customer action, (4) next steps. I'll own Veridian postmortem bullet.

sara: agree. I'll collect timelines and config diffs.

mike: :white_check_mark: closing loop on initial comms. Keep this thread updated with any rollback or additional reroutes.

incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated -> partial (routing changes applied). Next update scheduled at 08:51 UTC.

lina: noted. switching to incident-thread-monitor mode. ping me for any customer escalations.
